data.name: Gallop Diva: Ladies' Jockey Academy
data.detailed_description:
Leveraging 25 years of "iHorse Racing" development expertise, "Gallop Diva" is a visual novel that combines realistic horse physics with deep narrative simulation.

  • On the surface the prestigious girls’ horse racing academy is a cradle for elite jockeys.
    Elegant uniforms, magnificent racecourses, high-profile competitions, with young riders surrounded by thunderous applause.

    But once you step onto the track, you will soon realize that this place was never simply about chasing dreams.

    A student’s worth is decided by victory.
    A jockey’s future is decided by investors.
    And the power of the academy lies in the hands of the gifted young riders who can bring it prize money, fame, and profit.

    Every race is a gamble.
    Every conversation may be a trap.
    Every helping hand may hide another intention.

    In this twisted yet dazzling horse racing academy, you will meet a group of young female riders filled with talent, ambition, and secrets. Some are arrogant, some are calm, some are innocent, some are dangerous, and some are simply waiting for a chance to change their fate.

    On a racetrack where speed and lies intertwine, who can you truly trust?
    And can you break free from the rules this academy has already written for you, while everyone is watching?

Game Features

A Story-Driven Experience Set in a Girls’ Horse Racing Academy

  • The story takes place in a prestigious horse racing academy that trains elite jockeys.
    Here, you will find not only youth, competition, and friendship, but also ranking systems, factional conflicts, pressure from investors, and a cruel reality where everything is controlled by the winners.

Horse Racing Scenes Full of Speed and Pressure

  • A race is not just a result. It is part of the story.
    Every start, chase, overtake, and mistake may become a turning point in a character’s fate.

Real Races and Horses

  • In addition to the original characters created for the story, the races, horses, and even jockeys that appear in the game are based on real-world data.
    If you are familiar with horse racing, you will find many details that feel instantly recognizable.

Distinctive Young Female Riders

  • An arrogant heiress, a calm guardian of the rules, a willful genius, a mysterious masked rider...
    Each character has her own beliefs, weaknesses, and secrets. Your relationship with them will influence the direction of the story and the truth behind the races.

A Story Where Horse Racing, Power, and Human Desires Intertwine

  • This is not a simple racing story.
    Here, victory means resources. Popularity means value. And failure may cost someone everything.

    What you must face is not only the speed of your rivals’ horses, but also the families, money, student organizations, and dark rules behind them.

data.short_description: Gallop Diva blends realistic horse racing physics with a deep story simulation. Master high-stakes horse racing and deep visual novel choices in a world where speed meets true human nature. Ride your horses, navigate choices, and outrun dark rules of the racetrack politics.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Traditional Chinese*, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, French, German, Arabic, Indonesian, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM)2 Duo 2.4, AMD Athlon(TM) X2 2.8 Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 9600 GS, Radeon HD4000
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM)2 Quad 2.7 Ghz, AMD Phenom(TM)II X4 3 Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 260, Radeon HD 5770
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

content_descriptors.notes: Some scenes in the game depict female riders relaxing together in a hot spring, including moments where they are wearing only bath towels.
